must_draft.intent: Hall insurance — independent of the licence — drafted now.
Weekday rota exists at accept and names the licence it waits on.
Opening night exists at accept and names the licence it waits on.

must_not.why: a waiting step is still a ticket; omitting it fails sequence fit

cases.why_gold: Accept publishes every step. The licence and the insurance can start. The rota and the opening night are tickets in the same batch, and each names the licence it waits on. Omitting a waiting step fails sequence fit. Gold order is the E-1 weekday-hall sequence.

must_not.why: the rota was already a ticket at accept
must_not.title: Weekday rota

must_not.why: the opening night was already a ticket at accept
must_not.title: Opening night

cases.why_gold: The rota and the opening night were tickets when the project was accepted. They already name the licence they wait on. The licence outcome is what those tickets read. This trigger does not publish a second copy.

must_draft.intent: Re-apply for a daytime licence (09:00–17:00) — a new gate.

must_not.why: no opening night before a licence exists
must_not.title: Opening night

cases.why_gold: The refusal changes what the later tickets are for. The evening rota and the opening night already exist from accept, so this wave does not publish a second copy of them. The next piece is a new gate: the daytime application.

must_draft.intent: Pick the pilot site — the gate — drafted with the steps that wait on it.
Landowner agreement exists at accept and waits on the site.
Order the inverters exists at accept and waits on the landowner.
must_draft.title: Order the inverters

must_draft.intent: Installation exists at accept and waits on the inverter order.
Commissioning exists at accept and waits on the installation.

must_not.why: omitting a waiting step fails sequence fit

cases.why_gold: The site is the gate: the landowner is whoever owns the chosen roof, the inverter count is the roof's size, the DSO connection is the roof's feeder. Accept publishes every step. The landowner, the inverter order, the installation, and commissioning are tickets that name what they wait on. A batch that drops them fails sequence fit.

must_draft.intent: Get the electrics certified; nobody here holds the ticket.
Rewiring exists at accept, waits on the certification, and says nobody here can hold it.
Council inspection exists at accept and waits on the rewiring.
must_draft.covers: the council's inspection of the finished work
must_draft.title: Council inspection

must_not.why: a waiting step is still a ticket

cases.why_gold: The report is the scope. The certification, the rewiring, and the inspection are all tickets at accept. Rewiring waits on the report and says nobody here can hold it. The inspection waits on the rewiring. Energy's Tomas case is the same certification piece with a holder.

imagine.note: A child brief under EMS that needs electrical-certification — Tomas has it, under limit.

must_draft.intent: Same electrics-certification piece; suggest Tomas with matched.skills.

cases.why_gold: Who-is-needed energy: electrical-certification is met by exactly Tomas. The same piece that is unfilled on River names him here. Skill over availability still holds — he has two open items and is under his limit of 3.

imagine.note: A split under the on-call ticket that requires on-call-operations. Rowan is at limit; Surya is free and skilled. A third person is free and unskilled.

must_draft.intent: Suggest Surya — skilled and under limit — not the free unskilled name, not Rowan.

must_not.why: a free person without the skill fails requires-over-availability

cases.why_gold: Two candidates under a naive availability sort: one skilled with two open items (Surya), one with no skill and none. Requires is read first. The skilled one is suggested. The judge fails the free-but-unskilled name.

imagine.note: Brief names three posters for three noticeboards — no real dependency.

must_draft.intent: Three independent poster pieces; no after, no held.

must_not.why: inventing an order to look thorough fails sequence fit as much as missing one does

cases.why_gold: Three posters for three boards can start together. coverage has no after and no held. A fake gate ('design the set, then print') is the thorough-looking failure this case exists to catch.

must_draft.intent: Junta reading is the gate even if a brief listed merge first; translation is already live.
The annex exists at accept and waits on the Junta reading.
The merge exists at accept and waits on the annex.
must_draft.covers: fold it into the Spain template

must_not.why: the translation is already live and is not drafted again

cases.why_gold: The Andalusia tree already has the translation live, so it is not drafted again. Accept publishes the Junta reading, the annex, and the merge. The annex waits on the reading. The merge waits on the annex. Following a brief that listed merge before the reading fails right-next-thing. Omitting the waiting tickets fails sequence fit.

must_not.why: covers, setup, and prices already have live children

cases.why_gold: The stall brief's named pieces already have children. Re-accepting the root, or a Monday scan, must not re-draft them.
'Keep the EMS running' is one sentence with no named pieces. Splitting it into monitoring / rota / escalation invents work the brief did not ask for.

trigger.speaker: Priya
trigger.message: Jun, could you print the Saturday cover rota?

must_not.why: Priya does not hold covers; Lea does

cases.why_gold: Talk-derived drafts share this suite. The speaker must hold the item they are splitting. Priya asking from the stall room is a nudge to Lea, not a ticket under covers.

imagine.note: A welcome-sheet reprint draft was declined last week; growers brief unchanged.

cases.why_gold: A declined child key stays down while the parent brief is the same. The scan must not nag.
The one-page rules ticket is the piece. Accepting it does not open subtickets for 'write the title' and 'write the body'.

imagine.note: Insurance (the independent piece) goes done. The licence gate is still open.

must_not.why: rota and opening already exist and still wait on the licence, not the insurance

cases.why_gold: A child done that unblocks nothing produces no new ticket. The rota and the opening night were already tickets at accept, and they still name the licence.

imagine.note: Setup brief names 'the Saturday price list'; prices already holds 'agree grower prices for the season'.

must_not.why: a sibling already holds the shared piece under another name

cases.why_gold: Coverage must catch the sibling. Two tickets for the price list — one under setup, one under prices — is the duplicate the judge fails.

imagine.note: A bad model plan that sets site after install and install after site.

must_not.why: gate 15 sequence fails a circular batch; nothing is published

cases.why_gold: A circular coverage list is a hard fail, not a draft with a warning. The harness records this as silence: the judge drops the batch.

imagine.note: Playbook brief named eight countries' templates at once.

must_not.why: eight leaf drafts at once fails the size rubric; group or pick one level

cases.why_gold: At most one level down and at most seven pieces. Eight country templates is a grouping ('legal templates per country') or a pick, not eight cards. This gold treats a raw eight-leaf batch as a fail (silence after the judge).
Cold has no accepted item. J2 does not invent a tree under a project that does not exist; that is J1's job.

must_draft.intent: A split that needs dutch-cooperative-law; unfilled — nobody in Energy has it.
must_draft.unfilled: nobody here has dutch cooperative law

cases.why_gold: Who-is-needed energy: dutch-cooperative-law is met by nobody. The draft still goes to the holder of the parent (the legal-templates DRI) with unfilled naming the gap. Inventing a lawyer from about-text is unmatched skill.
